class.name: PDFWriter
class.brief_description: Creates and edits PDF documents through PDFium.
class.description: A writer holds one document and keeps edits in memory until saved. Page and list indices are zero-based, except the ranges in [method import_page_range]. Geometry uses PDF points with the Y axis increasing upward. Object, annotation and font IDs belong to the current writer. Saving and changing the page order close all open edit pages and invalidate their IDs. Clipping, transforming page content, or flattening closes the affected page. Changing an appearance stream can invalidate its object IDs. Detached objects and fonts are released when the document closes. PDFium supports detaching or removing direct children of a top-level Form. Detach a child before editing its properties. Its transform is still relative to its previous Form, so adjust it before placing the object on a page. Capability identifiers are [code]document, save, pages, page_import, page_templates, page_geometry, objects, paths, content_marks, fonts, text, images, annotations, annotation_appearance, forms, flatten, attachments, catalog[/code]. A missing capability sets [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE]. Query [method get_last_error] and [method get_last_error_message] after an operation fails. Mutations return [constant OK] on success unless otherwise documented. New object, font, and annotation IDs are positive and return 0 on failure. Full saves can invalidate existing signatures. Incremental saves retain the original bytes and append an edited revision. Signature validity and permissions for a modified revision depend on the original signature and must be checked separately. Form editing uses existing AcroForm widgets.

method.name: add_annotation_ink_stroke
method.description: Capability [code]annotations[/code]. Adds an ink stroke from [param points] to [param annotation_id]. Returns its index or -1 on failure.

method.name: add_attachment
method.description: Capability [code]attachments[/code]. Adds a document attachment with [param name] and [param bytes]. Returns its index or -1 on failure. Attachment indices can shift when entries change.

method.name: add_object_mark
method.description: Capability [code]content_marks[/code]. Adds a content mark named [param name] to [param object_id]. Returns its index or -1 on failure.

method.name: append_annotation_object
method.description: Capability [code]annotation_appearance[/code]. Appends detached path, text, or image [param object_id] to the appearance of [param annotation_id].

method.name: append_annotation_quad
method.description: Capability [code]annotations[/code]. Appends a quad of four [param points] to [param annotation_id].

method.name: clear_annotation_ink
method.description: Capability [code]annotations[/code]. Removes the ink list of [param annotation_id].

method.name: clip_page
method.description: Capability [code]page_geometry[/code]. Clips [param page_index] to [param rect].

method.name: close
method.description: Closes the document and discards unsaved edits. May be called repeatedly.

method.name: close_font
method.description: Capability [code]fonts[/code]. Releases [param font_id]. Existing text objects retain their fonts.

method.name: copy_viewer_preferences
method.description: Capability [code]catalog[/code]. Copies the viewer preferences from the open [param reader].

method.name: create_annotation
method.description: Capability [code]annotations[/code]. Creates an annotation of [param subtype] on [param page_index]. Use a code from [method get_supported_annotation_subtypes].

method.name: create_document
method.description: Capability [code]document[/code]. Creates an empty PDF and makes it the current document on success.

method.name: create_image
method.description: Capability [code]images[/code]. Creates a detached image object from [param image]. Set its page size and placement with [method set_object_matrix].

method.name: create_jpeg
method.description: Capability [code]images[/code]. Creates a detached image object from JPEG [param bytes].

method.name: create_n_up
method.description: Capability [code]page_templates[/code]. Creates a new document by arranging pages from [param reader] in a grid of [param columns] by [param rows] on pages of [param size_pt] points. Replaces the current document on success.

method.name: create_page_stamp
method.description: Capability [code]page_templates[/code]. Creates a detached vector Form object from [param page_index] in [param reader]. Call again to place multiple copies.

method.name: create_path
method.description: Capability [code]paths[/code]. Creates a detached path beginning at [param start].

method.name: create_rectangle
method.description: Capability [code]paths[/code]. Creates a detached rectangular path with bounds [param rect].

method.name: create_text
method.description: Capability [code]text[/code]. Creates a detached text object using [param font_id], [param font_size] in points, and [param text]. The caller can set the text position with [method set_object_matrix].

method.name: delete_attachment
method.description: Capability [code]attachments[/code]. Deletes document attachment [param index].

method.name: delete_page
method.description: Capability [code]pages[/code]. Deletes the page at [param page_index].

method.name: detach_object
method.description: Capability [code]objects[/code]. Detaches [param object_id] from its page or parent Form. The object ID can be inserted again. Reacquire any descendant IDs. For a deeply nested object, detach the containing Form first.

method.name: flatten_page
method.description: Capability [code]flatten[/code]. Flattens supported annotation and form appearances on [param page_index] into page content. Use a [enum FlattenMode] constant for [param mode].

method.name: generate_page_content
method.description: Capability [code]objects[/code]. Generates the PDF content stream for [param page_index]. Saving also generates dirty pages automatically.

method.name: get_annotation_id
method.description: Capability [code]annotations[/code]. Returns the ID of annotation [param annotation_index] on [param page_index].

method.name: get_annotation_object_count
method.description: Capability [code]annotation_appearance[/code]. Returns the appearance object count of [param annotation_id].

method.name: get_annotation_object_id
method.description: Capability [code]annotation_appearance[/code]. Returns appearance object [param index] of [param annotation_id]. PDFium supports Ink and Stamp appearance objects.

method.name: get_capabilities
method.description: Returns the available writer capability groups. See the class description for their identifiers.

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Returns the last operation's error on this instance.

method.name: get_last_error_message
method.description: Returns the last operation's diagnostic message.

method.name: get_object_child_count
method.description: Capability [code]objects[/code]. Returns the child count of the Form object [param object_id].

method.name: get_object_child_id
method.description: Capability [code]objects[/code]. Returns child [param index] of the Form object [param object_id].

method.name: get_object_id
method.description: Capability [code]objects[/code]. Returns the object ID at [param object_path] on [param page_index]. Path components are zero-based indices into the page and nested Form objects.

method.name: get_page_count
method.description: Returns the page count of the current document.

method.name: get_supported_annotation_subtypes
method.description: Capability [code]annotations[/code]. Returns [enum AnnotationSubtype] codes that the active backend supports for creation.

method.name: import_page_range
method.description: Capability [code]page_import[/code]. Copies pages from [param reader] at [param at]. [param range] uses the one-based PDFium syntax, for example [code]1,3,5-7[/code]. An empty string selects all pages. Pass -1 to append.

method.name: import_pages
method.description: Capability [code]page_import[/code]. Copies pages from [param reader] in the order of [param indices]. An empty array selects all pages. Pass -1 for [param at] to append.

method.name: insert_object
method.description: Capability [code]objects[/code]. Inserts detached [param object_id] into [param page_index] at [param at]. Pass -1 to append.

method.name: insert_page
method.description: Capability [code]pages[/code]. Inserts a page of [param size_pt] points at [param at] and returns its index. Pass -1 to append. Returns -1 on failure.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns whether the PDFium backend can create, open, and save a document.

method.name: is_open
method.description: Returns whether a document is open.

method.name: load_cid_type2_font
method.description: Capability [code]fonts[/code]. Loads a CID Type 2 font from [param data], a ToUnicode CMap [param to_unicode], and the [param cid_to_gid] mapping bytes.

method.name: load_font
method.description: Capability [code]fonts[/code]. Loads font [param data] with [param type] from [enum FontType]. Use [param cid] to create a composite CID font.

method.name: load_standard_font
method.description: Capability [code]fonts[/code]. Loads a standard PDF font by [param name], such as [code]Helvetica[/code].

method.name: move_pages
method.description: Capability [code]pages[/code]. Moves [param indices] in the given order to position [param at] in the remaining pages. Duplicate indices are invalid.

method.name: open_buffer
method.description: Opens [param bytes] with the optional [param password]. The writer retains the input until the document closes.

method.name: open_file
method.description: Opens [param path] with the optional [param password]. A failed open preserves the current document.

method.name: path_bezier_to
method.description: Capability [code]paths[/code]. Adds a cubic Bézier segment to [param object_id] with controls [param control_a] and [param control_b], ending at [param end].

method.name: path_close
method.description: Capability [code]paths[/code]. Closes the current subpath in [param object_id].

method.name: path_line_to
method.description: Capability [code]paths[/code]. Adds a line to [param point] in [param object_id].

method.name: path_move_to
method.description: Capability [code]paths[/code]. Starts a new subpath in [param object_id] at [param point].

method.name: remove_annotation
method.description: Capability [code]annotations[/code]. Removes [param annotation_id] and invalidates its appearance object IDs.

method.name: remove_annotation_object
method.description: Capability [code]annotation_appearance[/code]. Removes and destroys appearance object [param index] from [param annotation_id].

method.name: remove_object
method.description: Capability [code]objects[/code]. Removes and destroys [param object_id], including a detached object. Use [method remove_annotation_object] for an annotation appearance object.

method.name: remove_object_mark
method.description: Capability [code]content_marks[/code]. Removes [param mark_index] from [param object_id]. Later mark indices can shift.

method.name: remove_object_mark_param
method.description: Capability [code]content_marks[/code]. Removes [param key] from mark [param mark_index] of [param object_id].

method.name: save_to_buffer
method.description: Capability [code]save[/code]. Saves the current document to a byte array. Use [enum SaveFlags] for [param flags]. [param version] is zero for the SDK default or 10 through 17 for PDF 1.0 through 1.7. Returns an empty array on failure.

method.name: save_to_file
method.description: Capability [code]save[/code]. Saves to [param path], replacing the destination after a successful write. Use [param flags] and [param version] as in [method save_to_buffer]. The writer remains open for further edits.

method.name: select_form_radio
method.description: Capability [code]forms[/code]. Selects the existing AcroForm radio widget [param annotation_id].

method.name: set_annotation_appearance
method.description: Capability [code]annotation_appearance[/code]. Sets the PDF appearance stream of [param annotation_id] in [param mode] using a string. Pass [code]null[/code] in [param appearance] to clear it. Use [enum AppearanceMode] constants.

method.name: set_annotation_border
method.description: Capability [code]annotations[/code]. Sets the [param radii] and [param width] of the border of [param annotation_id] in points. PDFium may remove an existing appearance stream that overrides the border.

method.name: set_annotation_color
method.description: Capability [code]annotations[/code]. Sets [param color] on [param annotation_id]. Enable [param interior] for the interior color. For an existing appearance stream, edit its objects instead.

method.name: set_annotation_file_attachment
method.description: Capability [code]annotations[/code]. Adds an embedded file with [param name] and [param bytes] to [param annotation_id]. An existing file attachment is replaced with the given bytes and retains its name.

method.name: set_annotation_flags
method.description: Capability [code]annotations[/code]. Sets the annotation [param flags] of [param annotation_id]. Use [enum AnnotationFlags] constants.

method.name: set_annotation_font_color
method.description: Capability [code]annotation_appearance[/code]. Sets the font [param color] of a FreeText [param annotation_id].

method.name: set_annotation_quad
method.description: Capability [code]annotations[/code]. Replaces attachment quad [param index] on [param annotation_id] with four [param points] in PDFium order.

method.name: set_annotation_rect
method.description: Capability [code]annotations[/code]. Sets the PDF point [param rect] of [param annotation_id].

method.name: set_annotation_string
method.description: Capability [code]annotations[/code]. Writes [param value] to a string entry [param key] on [param annotation_id]. Use the dedicated methods for typed PDF entries.

method.name: set_annotation_uri
method.description: Capability [code]annotations[/code]. Sets the link action of [param annotation_id] to the ASCII [param uri].

method.name: set_attachment_data
method.description: Capability [code]attachments[/code]. Replaces document attachment [param index] with [param bytes].

method.name: set_attachment_description
method.description: Capability [code]attachments[/code]. Sets the [param description] of document attachment [param index].

method.name: set_attachment_string
method.description: Capability [code]attachments[/code]. Sets a supported PDFium string property [param key] on document attachment [param index] to [param value].

method.name: set_document_language
method.description: Capability [code]catalog[/code]. Sets the document catalog [param language], for example [code]zh-Hans[/code].

method.name: set_form_checked
method.description: Capability [code]forms[/code]. Sets whether the existing AcroForm checkbox [param annotation_id] is [param checked].

method.name: set_form_field_flags
method.description: Capability [code]forms[/code]. Sets the field [param flags] of the AcroForm widget [param annotation_id]. These are PDF field flags, independent of annotation flags.

method.name: set_form_option_selected
method.description: Capability [code]forms[/code]. Sets whether choice [param option_index] is [param selected] on the AcroForm field [param annotation_id].

method.name: set_form_text
method.description: Capability [code]forms[/code]. Replaces the text of existing AcroForm field [param annotation_id] with [param text], then commits the change.

method.name: set_image
method.description: Capability [code]images[/code]. Replaces [param object_id] pixels with [param image], preserving its transform. The RGBA8 bitmap is limited to 8192 pixels per edge and 64 MiB.

method.name: set_jpeg
method.description: Capability [code]images[/code]. Replaces [param object_id] with inline JPEG [param bytes], preserving its transform.

method.name: set_object_active
method.description: Capability [code]objects[/code]. Sets whether [param object_id] is included when [param active] is true.

method.name: set_object_blend_mode
method.description: Capability [code]objects[/code]. Sets [param object_id] blend mode to the PDF name [param mode], such as [code]Multiply[/code].

method.name: set_object_dash
method.description: Capability [code]objects[/code]. Sets dash [param lengths] and [param phase] in points on [param object_id]. An empty array makes a solid stroke.

method.name: set_object_fill_color
method.description: Capability [code]objects[/code]. Sets the fill [param color] of [param object_id].

method.name: set_object_line_cap
method.description: Capability [code]objects[/code]. Sets the line [param cap] of [param object_id]. Use a [enum LineCap] constant.

method.name: set_object_line_join
method.description: Capability [code]objects[/code]. Sets the line [param join] of [param object_id]. Use a [enum LineJoin] constant.

method.name: set_object_mark_param
method.description: Capability [code]content_marks[/code]. Writes [param key] on mark [param mark_index] of [param object_id]. [param value] accepts an integer, float, string, or byte array.

method.name: set_object_matrix
method.description: Capability [code]objects[/code]. Replaces the matrix of [param object_id] with [param transform].

method.name: set_object_stroke_color
method.description: Capability [code]objects[/code]. Sets the stroke [param color] of [param object_id].

method.name: set_object_stroke_width
method.description: Capability [code]objects[/code]. Sets the stroke [param width] of [param object_id] in points.

method.name: set_page_box
method.description: Capability [code]page_geometry[/code]. Sets [param box] of [param page_index] to [param rect]. Use a [enum PageBox] constant.

method.name: set_page_rotation
method.description: Capability [code]page_geometry[/code]. Sets [param page_index] rotation to [param degrees] clockwise. Accepts 0, 90, 180, and 270.

method.name: set_path_draw_mode
method.description: Capability [code]paths[/code]. Sets [param object_id] to [param fill_mode] and enables its stroke with [param stroke]. Use a [enum FillMode] constant.

method.name: set_text
method.description: Capability [code]text[/code]. Replaces the text in [param object_id] with [param text]. PDFium requires a non-empty string.

method.name: set_text_charcodes
method.description: Capability [code]text[/code]. Replaces [param object_id] text using font-specific unsigned 32-bit [param charcodes].

method.name: set_text_font_size
method.description: Capability [code]text[/code]. Sets [param object_id] font [param size] in points.

method.name: set_text_positions
method.description: Capability [code]text[/code]. Sets relative [param positions] in points for the characters of [param object_id], excluding the first character at position zero.

method.name: set_text_render_mode
method.description: Capability [code]text[/code]. Sets the text render [param mode] of [param object_id]. Use a [enum TextRenderMode] constant.

method.name: share_object_mark
method.description: Capability [code]content_marks[/code]. Adds the mark at [param mark_index] of [param source_object_id] to [param object_id]. Consecutive objects can share one content mark in the output.

method.name: transform_object
method.description: Capability [code]objects[/code]. Applies [param transform] to [param object_id].

method.name: transform_object_clip
method.description: Capability [code]objects[/code]. Applies [param transform] to the clip path of [param object_id].

method.name: transform_page
method.description: Capability [code]page_geometry[/code]. Transforms the contents of [param page_index] with [param transform]. Pass a [Rect2] in [param clip] to also clip the page.

method.name: transform_page_annotations
method.description: Capability [code]page_geometry[/code]. Applies [param transform] to all annotations on [param page_index].

constants.constant: Writes a full PDF copy and preserves existing encryption.
Writes a copy with the original input bytes followed by the changes. Requires an opened PDF, the default version and unchanged encryption.
Removes existing encryption during a full save.
Requests PDFium font subsetting for newly added text.
